verdict.rationale: Cekura documents its own cron jobs that 'run automated calls on a schedule to check the status of your agent and alert you if things fail.' Background ingestion also runs on its own: it pulls Retell call data every 30 seconds and schedules metric evaluation on incoming calls. This is a genuine recurring schedule, not a one-off action, but the automation is limited to scheduled test calls and evaluations, and the docs are thin on configuration depth. missing for 10: general-purpose automation beyond scheduled test calls/evaluations, detailed docs on configuring cron triggers, actions and alert channels, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Cron jobs run automated calls on a schedule to check the status of your agent and alert you if things fail.
Learn how to set up and manage automated cron jobs for your AI agent testing and evaluation workflows.
Cekura automatically pulls your call data from Retell's API every 30 seconds—no webhook configuration required.
Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation, and surfaces it in Observability.
